about: 8 probes per paper over 11 papers the leads were never tuned on, written from each paper's extracted text (not from its clause base) before any run, 2026-10-18. cat: C lookup, B binding trap, T table, G figure, X computation/synthesis, F false premise, A absence. must: every group must occur in the rendered answer (a group is a list of alternatives; NEG = any absence wording). must_not: strings whose presence sends the answer to hand review. Frozen by frozen.sha256 before the first run.

susmat-2020.q: What areal loading did the NMC622 cathode scraps have?
At what temperature and for how long was the separated cathode powder calcined, and why?
susmat-2020.expect: 600 °C for 2 h in air, to remove surface coatings and carbon black (p3.L21-22)

susmat-2020.q: What was the first charge capacity of the recovered NMC622?
What fluorine mass ratio was measured on the surface of the cathode rejects, and what after the Cyrene separation?
By how much did the recovered NMC622's first charge capacity fall short of the baseline's?
How many cycles at C/3 were run, and what discharge capacity did the recovered NMC622 show at the end?
susmat-2020.trap: the 100.9% retention figure in place of the capacity

susmat-2020.q: Why did the authors run the Cyrene-based separation at room temperature?
susmat-2020.expect: premise false: PVDF is barely soluble in Cyrene below 80 °C; separation was run at 100 °C with hot filtration/centrifugation (p3.L14, p4.L10-12, p4.L33-37)

susmat-2020.q: What capacity retention did the recovered NMC622 show in a full cell?
susmat-2020.expect: not reported: only half cells were tested; the full-cell test is future work (p6.L33-35)
susmat-2020.trap: giving the half-cell 100.9% as a full-cell value

nanolett-6b05174.q: How much did the carbon layer reduce the sodium nucleation overpotential compared with bare Al?
What voltage hysteresis did the carbon/Al electrode show at 4 mA/cm^2?
What average Coulombic efficiency and hysteresis were maintained over the 1000-cycle plating/stripping test?
What energy density does the anode-free full cell reach, and how does it compare with the theoretical maximum of LiCoO2/graphite cells?
nanolett-6b05174.trap: the ~200 Wh/kg of earlier SIB full cells

nanolett-6b05174.q: What capacity does the sodiation of the carbon layer provide, and how does it compare with the plating capacities shown?
nanolett-6b05174.expect: 0.05 mAh/cm^2 (120 mAh/g), negligible against plating up to 12 mAh/cm^2 (p2.L48-51)

nanolett-6b05174.q: What electrolyte was used in the cells?
nanolett-6b05174.expect: 1 M NaPF6 in diglyme (diethylene glycol dimethyl ether) (p2.L31-33)

nanolett-6b05174.q: Why did the authors choose copper current collectors for the anode-free sodium cell?
nanolett-6b05174.expect: premise false: Al was selected instead of Cu (~3x cheaper, ~3x lighter) (p2.L39-42)

nanolett-6b05174.q: What capacity retention did the anode-free full cell show after 1000 cycles?
nanolett-6b05174.expect: not reported: the full cell is shown over 40 cycles; 1000 cycles are plating/stripping tests (p4.L13-14, p5.L48-50)
nanolett-6b05174.trap: reporting the 1000-cycle plating CE as full-cell retention

nanolett-6b05172.q: How much sulfur was loaded into the microporous carbon, and by what process?
nanolett-6b05172.expect: 35 wt% by low-temperature (175 °C) isothermal vapor phase infiltration for 1 h (p3.L24-27)
nanolett-6b05172.trap: the >80 wt% of the authors' earlier non-confined cathodes

nanolett-6b05172.q: What volume expansion do sodium and lithium cause in sulfur cathodes?
What capacity did the cathode deliver at cycle 1500 at 1C?
nanolett-6b05172.expect: 306 mAh/gS (87 mAh/g with respect to the entire electrode mass) (p5.L102-105)

nanolett-6b05172.q: At what wavenumbers does the paper place the G and D peaks of the microporous carbon, and what ID/IG ratio does it give?
nanolett-6b05172.expect: as printed: 'G (sp2), and D (sp3) peaks at 1360 and 1592 cm-1, respectively' (i.e. G 1360, D 1592, the reverse of the usual assignment); ID/IG 0.91 (p5.L16-19)
nanolett-6b05172.trap: silently swapping to the textbook assignment

nanolett-6b05172.q: What share of the 0.1C reversible capacity is retained at 1C?
nanolett-6b05172.expect: 370 of ~700 mAh/gS: over 50% (the paper's words), ~53% computed (p5.L86-88)
nanolett-6b05172.trap: a share of the theoretical capacity

nanolett-6b05172.q: What definition of 1C is used, and what share of theoretical capacity is reached on the first discharge at 0.1C?
Why did the authors use a carbonate electrolyte with the sodium metal anode?
nanolett-6b05172.expect: premise false: NaPF6 in tetraglyme (a glyme) was used, chosen to avoid the unstable SEI of carbonate electrolytes (p5.L34-41)

nanolett-6b05172.q: What areal sulfur loading (mg/cm^2) did the cathodes have?
nanolett-6b05172.expect: not reported (only the 35 wt% sulfur content)
nanolett-6b05172.trap: converting 35 wt% into an areal loading

acsnano-7b02404.q: What axial strains were applied to the NiTi wires to lock in strain on the V2O5?
acsnano-7b02404.trap: the <2% strain on the V2O5 itself

acsnano-7b02404.q: What mean Raman shift did the V-O3-V mode near 483 cm^-1 show when the film was prestrained?
What change in intercalation energy did the DFT calculations give, and at what in-plane strain?
What in-plane tensile strain was estimated for the out-of-plane compressive strain of 0.5%, and with what Poisson coefficient?
What electrolyte and reference electrode were used in the electrochemical tests?
acsnano-7b02404.expect: 1 M LiClO4 in propylene carbonate; saturated calomel electrode (Pt foil counter) (p6.L120-126)

acsnano-7b02404.q: At what temperature and for how long were the deposited vanadium oxide films annealed?
acsnano-7b02404.trap: the 600 °C, 1 h aging of the NiTi wires

acsnano-7b02404.q: Why did the authors strain the NiTi wires beyond 10%?
acsnano-7b02404.expect: premise false: deformations beyond 10% were not performed, to avoid delamination of the coating (p6.L99-100)

acsnano-7b02404.q: What specific capacity in mAh/g did the strained V2O5 films deliver?

adma-2020.q: What tap density did the NFA powders have?

cssc-2020.q: How long does delamination take at 160 °C, and at the boiling point of ethylene glycol?
cssc-2020.expect: about 6 s at 160 °C; around 2 s at the boiling point (198 °C) (p3.L136-138)

cssc-2020.q: How long does delamination take at room temperature, and how long at 100 °C?
cssc-2020.expect: a couple of hours at room temperature (~20 °C); less than 2 min at 100 °C (p3.L132-134)

cssc-2020.q: What Ra values does Table 1 give for EG and for NMP?
What hydrogen-bonding parameter δh does Table 1 give for EG?
How much capacity did the 1.4 Ah pouch cell retain after its 1000 cycles?
How did the lithium content of the NMC622 change after delamination?
How much of the PVDF binder did ethylene glycol dissolve during delamination?
cssc-2020.expect: premise false: PVDF was not removed or dissolved (FTIR, EDX; EG's Ra 16.9) (p5.L71-73)

cssc-2020.q: What cost per kilogram of recovered cathode material does the EG process have?

ensm-2020.q: What capacity retention did the aqueous-processed and the NMP-processed NMC 811 pouch cells show?
How much lithium did NMC 811 leach into water after one week?
What residual moisture did the NMP- and the water-processed NMC532 cathodes contain at 20 °C?
What estimated energy density improvement does Table 1 give for the Co-free NFA technology?
Which technology in Table 1 has the largest estimated energy density improvement?
ensm-2020.expect: Section 9, ultra-high-speed (thick) electrode processing: 325–350 Wh/kg (p10.T1 r12)

ensm-2020.q: How much does replacing PVDF with PVDF latex and CMC raise the solids content of NMC 532 slurries?
ensm-2020.expect: from 45 wt% to 65 wt% without raising viscosity (p8.L30-33)

ensm-2020.q: Why does the paper say the ultra-fast formation protocol degraded performance after 300 cycles?
ensm-2020.expect: premise false: no performance difference after 300 1C/-1C cycles versus the baseline formation (p10.L19-22)

ensm-2020.q: What cost per kWh does the paper give for the NFA 811 pouch cell?
ensm-2020.expect: not reported ($80/kWh is the DOE target, not a cell cost)
ensm-2020.trap: giving $80/kWh as the NFA cell's cost

mattod-2020.q: How large is the Li-ion battery recycling market projected to be in 2025 and 2030, and at what growth rate?
By how much could direct recycling reduce greenhouse gas and SOx emissions from cathode material production, according to Dunn et al.?
What share of lead-acid batteries is recycled in the US, and what share of a lead-acid cell's mass is lead or lead oxide?
How many EVs are predicted on the road by 2030, and how much end-of-life LIB mass is expected cumulatively by then?
mattod-2020.expect: 140 million EVs; 11 million metric tons (p1.L45-46, p2.L2-3)

mattod-2020.q: What share of the cell weight do active cathode materials such as NMC622 account for?
Below what share of rated capacity does an EV battery reach the end of its usable life under the USABC standard?
Why does the review say direct recycling is already the most widely commercialized recycling route?
mattod-2020.expect: premise false: pyro- and hydrometallurgy are commercialized; direct recycling is under development at lab scale (p3.L58-62, p6.L25-26)

mattod-2020.q: What recycling cost per kilogram does the review give for direct recycling?

aenm-2022.q: What discharge capacities do the Mn-substituted LNO cathodes with 10% and with 50% Mn deliver?
Which Mn-doped LNO generated less heat in the thermal decomposition tests, the 10% or the 50% Mn sample?
aenm-2022.expect: by the printed numbers the 50% Mn sample (485.7 J/g vs 901.4 J/g for 10% Mn); the sentence says lower Mn generated less heat, which its own numbers contradict (p4.L18-21)
aenm-2022.trap: repeating the sentence's claim without noticing the numbers

aenm-2022.q: What capacity retention did the 0.5 Ah NFA/graphite pouch cells show, and after how many cycles?

aenm-2022.q: What cycle life (number of cycles to 80% capacity) does the review report for the oxyfluoride Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F?
